note: `ceiling` is REQUIRED — a role states its ceiling explicitly; omission is not "everything".
`approveScope` is REQUIRED — absence must not be read as either "none" or "the same as the ceiling".
Role names are lowercase hyphenated identifiers.
Role names are at most 64 characters.
A role ceiling names capabilities, it does not grant them — `additive` has no meaning on a ceiling.
Ceiling items are CapabilityRef objects, not bare strings, and there is no wildcard.
`builtIn` is not settable — a defined role is always custom.
